explicit_narrowing_and_source_notes: The official API permits more OrderType and TimeInForce values than the initial Stage8 policy; Stage8 remains MARKET/LIMIT and DAY only.
The existing builder can serialize GTC/IOC/FOK, so the future Stage8 capability preflight must reject every non-DAY value before invoking it.

The existing July fixture has the complete current TIF, ValidBefore and OrderStatus sets but no separate OrderType array; the current full official OrderType set is frozen in the Stage8A-0 normalized snapshot.
FINAM public REST does not expose a distinct qty_step field; Decimal::ONE is an explicit local futures policy and must not be represented as broker-observed truth.
The mapper can decode optional legacy/extended future detail fields but has documented top-level min_step/lot_size and contract_size fallback paths for the current public contract.
Outgoing comments remain Disabled/None in the initial Stage8 policy even though the existing builder supports a vetted optional OutgoingOrderComment.
required_future_preflight: exact durable ClientOrderId is non-empty and <=20
instrument symbol/tick/lot/qty-step/multiplier/schedule prerequisites are current and validated
